en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a cobblestone avenue lined with two‑story brick buildings that host shops on the ground floor and apartments above. An early 20th‑century automobile and a few pedestrians are visible in the foreground, along with a kiosk and telegraph poles. On the left is a building with a small dome. The caption at the bottom reads "REZEKNE – LATGALES PROSPEKTS."
